t: Mains-powered disc cutter, perfect for cutting masonry, metal and more. Unlike a grinder, this tool has been specifically designed to cut. With benefits including large cut capacity for blade size and an ergonomic design for better user posture whilst providing increased safety and accuracy. The reinforced skid plate with a raised angle lifts the blade away from the floor so the machine can be put down straight after the cut. Built-in wheels give accuracy when making long, straight cuts at ground level and reduces user fatigue. The powerful electric motor makes light work of all types of masonry including reinforced concrete. The central position gives a balanced centre of gravity.
